title: Bulk-silicon computational campaign
status_detail: The human requested a process for meeting the project's computational goals and then responded exactly `let's turn this into a task, with subtasks and subsubtasks, etc`. This records one milestone-oriented bulk-silicon campaign above the existing production-reference, band-edge, Wannier, reduced-model, and semiconductor-property boundaries without activating scientific execution. Only the separately authorized direct-results disposition child is selected; protected calculations, downstream milestones, and automatic successor activation remain inactive.
objective: Coordinate the shortest scientifically credible bulk-silicon path from a numerically verified production Kohn-Sham parent through band-edge, Wannier, and reduced-model milestones while preserving explicit provenance, evidence classes, iteration boundaries, and independent parallel branches.
authorized_scope: Coordinate existing milestone parents for the production reference, band-edge characterization, Wannier reference, reduced-model construction, and semiconductor properties without duplicating their domain ownership.

Use the lifecycle scientific question -> frozen inputs and metrics -> compiled run manifest -> protected-execution authorization -> execution -> immutable receipts and external artifacts -> typed compact extraction -> deterministic analysis -> numerical verification -> human scientific disposition -> accepted downstream parent.
Keep scientific critical-path, Wannier, software-integration, and documentation work independent unless they consume the same mutable scientific parent or artifact set.

Require one bounded authorization envelope for each protected campaign, naming executable identity, exact parameter matrix, maximum invocations, resource ceilings, outputs, retry policy, stop conditions, and acceptance rules.

Use human checkpoints only for material scientific choices, protected execution, evidence acceptance, and release or publication; deterministic corrections and software gates remain within their owning authorized milestone.
completion_criteria: BulkSiReference-v1, BulkSiBandEdge-v1, BulkSiWannier-v1, and BulkSiReducedModel-v1 are each accepted or explicitly rejected under their owning evidence and claim boundaries.
Every protected execution has an exact authorization envelope, immutable compact provenance, external-artifact identities, and explicit resource and stop-condition evidence.
Software verification, numerical verification, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, parent-model error, and model-reduction error remain separately classified.
Conditional semiconductor-property branches are either accepted under their own evidence or explicitly deferred without blocking the shortest electron effective-mass path.
No child is activated automatically and no downstream result consumes an unidentified, mutable, incompatible, or unaccepted parent.
exclusions: This parent performs no Quantum ESPRESSO, Wannier90, remote, cluster, cloud, or other protected execution.
Do not treat parent containment, a static graph edge, passing software tests, or successful executable invocation as scientific acceptance or successor authority.
Do not merge purpose-specific SCF, path, valley, Wannier, DOS, fitting, or validation datasets merely for operational convenience.
Do not expand the active campaign into phonons, electron-phonon coupling, mobility, device simulation, another material system, release, or publication without separate authority.
